title: Contra Fulgentium Donatistam
author: Auctor Incertus
source: Translated by Claude from tmp740.tmp740.opp-lat1, as held by Open Greek and Latin's Patrologia Latina.
statement: An AI-generated translation. No specialist has reviewed it.

passages.original: Augustinus respondit: Quid ergo facies? Fulg. dixit : Docebo illum ecclesiam meam case certissimam.
passages.english: Augustine replied: "What, then, will you do?" Fulgentius said: "I will show him that my church is the most certain."
passages.notes: "case" is read as a scanning error for "esse" ("is"). "Fulg." is expanded as Fulgentius, the Donatist named in the title. "Certissimam" could also be taken as "most assured" or "beyond doubt" [the true church].
